rationale: Both candidates independently surface the same latent gap (hunyuan_image3_transformer.py's un-swept get_cache_scale caller) and both echo the ground truth's core concern that the new test verifies the mapper is called/accepted but not that it resolves against a real quantized checkpoint / outer AutoWeightsLoader. X is more exhaustive but pads its findings with a duplicated, self-admittedly 'unverifiable' major claim about tensor-shape squeezing, and cites an unverifiable PR-description quote, which drags down precision. Y reaches the same key findings more concisely, grounds its correctness claim in an actual read of upstream vLLM source (utils.py, fp8.py, weight_utils.py) rather than speculation, and lands on the same approve-with-caveats verdict the real reviewers gave.
